items.title: 62% Undervalued? Charter Communications (CHTR) As Edge AI Expansion Meets A Share Slide
items.summary: Spectrum’s plan to activate AI capable computing across more than 1,000 embedded edge facilities gives Charter Communications (CHTR) a fresh angle on its broadband footprint, as investors reassess a sharply weaker year to date share performance. Charter Communications has been rolling out these edge AI partnerships just as sentiment has weakened, with the share price down 27.96% over the past 30 days and 47.12% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return has fallen 59.77%. items.title: Comcast’s Dividend Keeps Growing While the Market Treats It Like a Melting Ice Cube
items.summary: Comcast sits near a 52-week low with a fresh Sell rating, yet its free cash flow dwarfs what it costs to pay shareholders every quarter. Something in that math deserves a closer look before the market's verdict gets accepted as fact.

items.summary: Analysts at KeyBanc cite concerns about Comcast’s subscriber losses, slowdown in theme parks, and the NBCUniversal spinoff.

items.title: The Cheapest Stocks in the S&P 500: Are They a Bargain or a Trap?
items.summary: Inflation is stubbornly high, but not in home broadband service.  There, telecom operators are making fiberoptic inroads in a business long dominated by cable television companies.  The result has been discounting:  UBS  reports that prices for various broadband service tiers are down 7% to 14% for fiber over the past year, and 17% to 27% for cable.

items.title: Are You Overpaying For Verizon Stock Versus Its Rivals?
items.summary: A $10,000 stake in Verizon Communications (VZ) a year ago is now worth about $11,660, the top result in its group of five. Verizon ranks only third of the five on revenue growth and third again on operating margin. So are you paying for what Verizon earns today, or for a recovery it has only started to show.
